thesis: The page is the story pole itself: a vertical ruler marks every section at a real Albany rowhouse height, and every claim is a measurement, a tolerance, or a sample price that the homeowner can verify before calling.

signature.name: Story Pole Ruler
signature.summary: A vertical graphite ruler in the left margin with tick marks at real rowhouse heights (0-132 in); active tick highlights in pencil-mark orange on scroll; dimension callouts, service height tags, tool readouts and review tolerance pills all align to the same scale.

motion.intro: Ruler draws down 0-132 in via clip-path wipe; hero callouts count to value; 1.1 s, skippable.
stories: active tick slides to section mark on scroll
motion.hover: 1 px pencil-mark underline grows from left via scaleX on links and buttons
